subject: CFTypeID

observation.summary: CFBase.h declares CFTypeID twice under an #if defined(__LLP64__) && __LLP64__ guard: 'unsigned long long' on LLP64 and 'unsigned long' otherwise. A clang -E probe on this arm64 Darwin host reports __LLP64__ is NOT defined, so the LP64 arm64 branch ('unsigned long', 8 bytes) is the one in effect on macOS 27 arm64.

claim: On arm64 macOS 27, CFTypeID is the LP64 branch 'typedef unsigned long CFTypeID' (64-bit), because Darwin does not define __LLP64__; CFTypeID is a typedef and therefore has no Mach-O export of its own.
